job.title: IT Engineering (Software, Platform & Network) – 2027 Grads
job.pay_full: $92,000 – $116,500 a year starting pay; total rewards include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits

details.about: Procter & Gamble is hiring 2027 graduates into IT engineering at its Cincinnati General Offices, across software, platform and network engineering. The work could range from data pipelines that feed machine learning models on petabytes of data, to consumer Internet of Things platforms, to serverless applications for business areas from HR to information security. P&G IT engineers solve business problems with technology: hands-on coding, debugging, automation and continuous learning.
duties: Software engineering: turn requirements and user stories into scalable, maintainable designs and high-quality code; develop, test and support it through the lifecycle with CI/CD tools
Network engineering: design, implement and maintain network infrastructure, plan technology lifecycles, validate new capabilities and act as an escalation point for critical network issues
Platform engineering: manage cloud platforms with configuration management, drive platform standards, resolve cloud and security incidents and lead proof-of-concept work
Work with product, operations and cross-functional teams, and share knowledge with P&G's engineering community
needs: Graduating in Spring or Summer 2027 with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical/IT field
Strong problem-solving skills and programming experience (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go); no specific language required
Strong understanding of network hardware and infrastructure such as routers, hubs, servers, VPNs and switches
Ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical colleagues
nice: A history of solving hard problems with creative solutions
Experience with Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform
details.benefits: Starting pay $92,000 – $116,500 a year. Total rewards at P&G include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits; the recruiter may share more about total rewards during the hiring process.
notes: Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role
